text:
lauren_marketing: Noticed a spike in 'unassigned' for webinar signups this morning (~4%). HS webhook shows timeouts between 09:10-09:18 PT. Anyone on call?

ryan_salesops: I saw the same. Enrichment service 429/504s during the burst. Looks like our external enrichment provider returned rate-limit errors.

lauren_marketing: Impact: a few high-fit leads didn't get assigned to SDRs. We need a short-term handoff fix and a plan for permanent resilience.

sasha_sdr: Which leads? I can manually claim if we have IDs. Also worried about churn in follow-up SLA.

ryan_salesops: Pulling list now. We have ~28 unassigned. Prioritizing by account score.

vik_ops: Temporary mitigation options:
- flip HS round-robin fallback to a shared marketing queue for 1h
- enable immediate retry with exponential backoff for webhook (retries: 4, base: 1s)
- add a rule in HS to requeue leads with enrichment failures to 'awaiting-enrich' workflow
Which do we want?

lauren_marketing: Prefer marketing-queue fallback for 60m + retry tweak. Avoid overloading a single rep. Also enable alerting on >1% unassigned over 10m.

ryan_salesops: Agree. I'll run the backfill after fallback applied. Also request that VIP domains (listed in #vip-accounts) get immediate manual claim flag.

eng-bot: incident: enrichment-provider rate limit spike detected at 1759990022. Error types: 429 (rate limit), 504 (gateway timeout).

vik_ops: Applied HS fallback -> marketing-shared for 60m at 1759990032. Enabled webhook retries: {retries:4, strategy:exponential, base_s:1}. Added alert rule to monitoring.

ryan_salesops: Running backfill now. Starting with high-fit list, will report progress.

lauren_marketing: Thanks. Follow-up items for Monday sync:
- durable fallback design (circuit-breaker + per-source backoff)
- add unassigned-by-source dashboard and SLA alerts
- confirm SF mapping for redelegated leads
- test load against enrichment provider (rate limits)
Can someone own the doc?

sasha_sdr: I can own the one-pager with handoff steps and manual claim playbook.

ryan_salesops: Backfill done: 26/28 assigned, 2 require manual outreach (IDs: 2145, 2146). Noted VIPs claimed.

lauren_marketing: Great. Closing the loop: leave fallback in place until end of day and rollback if stable. Thanks team :raised_hands:
